notes.title: One Week On & Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

Firstly, thank you to everyone for playing Blossom Tales 2: The Minotaur Prince, we hope you're having a grand adventure!

Thanks to our players we caught a bug causing some people to fall into the water around Sunkiss Canyon and being unable to get out. We are delighted that we've introduced a patch to fix this, as well as a few other things. Check out the full patch notes below.

[b]Full patch notes v1.01: [/b]
[list]
[*] Addition of a teleport fix for the northern canyon's water. Fixing the water issue, so you are teleported back to land.
[*] Fix for the 'grapple over the mermaid' bug.
[*] Expanded the telescope collision box in the wizard house, to allow for bottom access.
[*] Fix for incorrect Grandma dialogue directions. Previously stated Morkla was to the west, but emerald jungles are to the east.
[*] Fix for small graphic issue with the potion selector box on the alchemy screen.
[*] Fix for incorrect directions from the 'sleepy guy' in Blossomdale tavern for the buried treasure.
[*] Edit/change to the anchor. Moving it down a couple of pixels on the island "overworld". So it can be seen with reduced cam motion enabled.
[*] Addition of the map below the island chest bug area "overworld" to the teleport fix above.
[/list]
We've been seeing (and reading) a number of incredible reviews across Press and Content Creator outlets and wanted to share them with you

[b]9.5/10[/b] - Game Grin
[b]85% [/b]- Cog Connected
[b]84%[/b] - SwitchUp
[b]8.25/10[/b] - Game Informer
[b]8/10[/b] - Switch Corner
[b]7/10[/b] - Nintendo Life
[b]7/10[/b] - Destructoid

If you've been enjoying[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747830/Blossom_Tales_II_The_Minotaur_Prince/] Blossom Tales 2: The Minotaur Prince[/url] please leave it a review. Reviews are super helpful on Steam as it helps the game reach more players, and most importantly, we love to read them :)

Love the soundtrack? You can pick up the soundtrack on Josie's [url=https://visager.bandcamp.com/album/blossom-tales-ii-the-minotaur-prince-original-game-soundtrack]Bandcamp here[/url], or you can stream it on most streaming platforms.

[url=https://visager.bandcamp.com/album/blossom-tales-ii-the-minotaur-prince-original-game-soundtrack][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259404/614b907561114b46990121c16251a8a56c225875.png[/img][/url]

Have a wonderful week!

- Castle Pixel & Playtonic Friends.

notes.title: Release date announcement and the Limited Run Showcase
notes.notes:
Fellow Knights,

The time for your newest adventure is close at hand! We're excited to announce that Blossom Tales 2: The Minotaur Prince is set to launch on [b]16th August 2022[/b] for Steam and Nintendo Switch!!

And that's not all...

If you missed the Limited Run Games Showcase (you can watch it [url=https://www.twitch.tv/limitedrungames]here[/url]), we debuted a brand new trailer AND announced that Blossom Tales 2 will be getting a physical release on Nintendo Switch. The release date is still TBA, but we'll make sure to let you know when it's set to be available for pre-order.

Take a look at the trailer...

[previewyoutube=F_XqdYRzG-A;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget to wishlist on Steam and follow us on our social channels to be kept up-to-date.
